# Coming in 2.9: Crops NH
**Crops NH is a complete overhaul and replacement for IC2 crops.**

## 🧑‍🌾  Fully replaces IC2 Crops
- All existing crops and crop-related items will be automatically migrated.
- Some crops now require soils other than farmland; you’ll have to break the crop sticks to get your seeds and replant them on an appropriate soil.
- Crop sticks are now actually called crop sticks!
-# 🙏 The only crop that didn’t make the cut was the eating plant, may it rest forever in farms above.
## 🧑‍🌾  Improved Farming
* All seeds come with new, visually distinct icons.
* We’ve got proper NEI tabs that let you see all the drops and growth requirements for any given crop.
* Improved tooltips and WAILA messages that tell you exactly what’s wrong with your crops.
* Farms no longer need to be at y>124; we’ve reworked the environmental stat system, and it's a lot simpler to work with!
* Just watering your crops and being in a high-humidity biome will get you most of the way there.
* If you want your crops to grow at maximum efficiency, check the quest book for more details!
* Resistance no longer gets in the way of growth speed, and lets you safely use crops above 23 growth as long as its value is greater than or equal to its growth!
* A maxed-out resistance will guarantee a seed drop (you only need 10 if you’re harvesting with a reinforced spade!)
* Crops that would have been overtaken by weeds or died due to a bad environment now turn into sick crops, and can be cured with plant cure!
-# 😉 Farmers looking to set up large _fertilized_ fields might want to take a look at the forestry multifarm.
## 🧑‍🌾  Improved Breeding
* In addition to the old randomized breeding system, Crops NH draws inspiration from bees, allowing you to breed deterministically.
* We’ve also added a spreading mechanic inspired by Agricraft, letting you easily replicate and improve the stats of a given crop by setting up a long line of crop sticks.
* With a good eye for detail, you should be able to distinguish every crop by its first stage.
* Breeding for better stats is now easier than ever, as offspring won’t lose stats when all the parents have some fertilizer in them.
* There’s also a machine to help you breed crops deterministically. (It’s also required in order to breed higher tiers of material crops)
* The plant lens now fully scans crops, making early crop breeding a breeze.
* We’ve also got NEI tabs for deterministic and random mutations!
-# 🥀 Say goodbye to your faithful OC crop bot, it has served you well.
## 🧑‍🌾  Improved Crop Processing
* Crops no longer use UUM to renewably generate resources; instead, they use acids.
* Most recipes have been moved to the forge hammer, and most have had their craft time adjusted.
* Ore crops can now be turned into impure crushed ores in addition to purified ores. 
-# 🛢️Have you found an oil field with a large quantity of the wrong type of oil? Use oil berries and convert them to your favourite oil type!
## 🧑‍🌾  Introducing the Industrial Farm:
* Unlocked in MV and scales throughout the tiers with its tiered seed beds and upgrade units!
* The length of the multi depends on the tier of seed beds you use, and each extra block of length lets you slot more upgrades.
* The upgrades are tired and must match the tier of your seed bed.
* Power consumption is based on the upgrades you have installed and the tier of your seed bed.
* It will be required in order to grow higher-tier crops.
-# 🪦 The EIG has finally lost its battle to the infamous 8 EU/t MV crop manager and will lose its ability to grow crops going forward.
## 🧑‍🌾  Improved Quests
* The crops page in the quest book has been fully updated and should now be able to guide you through your farming journey!
-# 📣 Shoutout to SRose for the work on the quests!

Can’t wait for 2.9? Good news, Crops NH is now part of our daily releases.

-# Massive thanks June and Embri for the help with the textures!
